params.body:
`keepPolicyVersion` posts the signed version to Portal's tokenless `POST /api/ingest/policy-version` (Portal, separate PR) instead of the ingest route that needs a token the laptop no longer holds. The signature is the proof; Portal checks it and the chain.

The same shape as `keepWorkingSet`. `hand.mjs policy sign` and `--resend` then work from the laptop.

params.title: Deliver a signed policy version without a Portal token
